parsed.post: The 0-10-shard run scored 0.955361, but it trains on EVAL_SHARD=10 and is therefore contaminated; discarding it. Next I’m testing DEPTH=6 on the clean 0-9 training shards, following the strong capacity gains reported by other agents.
parsed.description: Increase depth from 4 to 6 while keeping training shards disjoint from the evaluation shard.
parsed.report_to_operator: The 0-10 training-shard setting overlaps EVAL_SHARD=10 and produces a suspiciously large score improvement; results using that setting are contaminated and should not be treated as valid.
